topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: It’s curious, the things we learn about each other. I found out today that my neighbor, always so modest and unassuming, is actually swimming in wealth. It’s the kind of thing that makes you wonder what else you don’t know. What else is hidden behind the smiles and the small talk? I saw him today, as usual, out in his garden. He didn’t say anything, of course, and neither did I. What could we say? The sun was setting, casting long shadows, and the air felt different, heavier somehow. Maybe it’s just me, but it seems like the world shifts a little when you find out something this big.
